crossRefs.note: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s…
The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.
Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted…
For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to…
and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

translations.web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
translations.bsb: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
translations.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
translations.asv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up. Psalm 76 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a song.
